items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund that scales with valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將5%股份投入新公益基金，估值成長時可追加
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it will commit 5% of its shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a wholly-owned LLC, subject to stockholder approval. An additional 2% can be added at board discretion for every 50% increase in company value above a baseline. Combined with founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares are now dedicated to public good, with no lobbying or political use of the equity.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布將把5%股份投入全新的 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund（全資擁有的LLC），需股東批准。公司估值每較基準線上升50%，董事會可再追加最多2%。加上創辦人與員工捐贈承諾，約20%股份將用於公益，且該股權不用於遊說或政治捐獻。
items_flat.analysis_en: This structure directly ties Anthropic’s commercial growth to expanding public-benefit resources as a public benefit corporation, distinguishing it from typical tech equity practices. Governance details, exact valuation thresholds, and distribution mechanisms remain undisclosed, leaving the practical impact uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此結構將商業成長直接連結至公益資源擴張，符合其公益公司定位，有別於一般科技公司的股權做法。治理細節、估值門檻與分配機制尚未公布，實際影響仍不明朗。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將把 Anthropic 的部分股份投入 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund，這是一個新實體，其持股結構會隨著公司成長而增加。

items_flat.title_en: MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash with claimed generational leap in agentic and coding tasks
items_flat.title_zh: MiniMax 推出 M3.1 Flash，宣稱代理與程式任務能力代際躍升
items_flat.summary_en: MiniMax officially rolled out M3.1 Flash on October 19, describing it as a next-generation Flash model that delivers major improvements in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use, and cybersecurity, with nearly 3x faster online inference and 70% lower usage costs. API pricing is $0.15/$0.60 per million input/output tokens; model weights are scheduled for October 23. The company noted an earlier anonymous version had processed over 200T tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: MiniMax 於10月19日正式推出 M3.1 Flash，定位為新一代 Flash 模型，在代理任務、程式設計、Computer Use 與網路安全上實現代際提升，線上推理速度近三倍、使用成本降低70%。API 定價為每百萬輸入/輸出 token $0.15/$0.60，模型權重預計10月23日開放。公司表示其早期匿名版本已處理超過200T token。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release underscores Chinese labs’ ability to deliver high agentic capability at aggressive price and speed points, potentially pressuring frontier pricing. Independent verification of the self-reported benchmark gains and the forthcoming open weights will determine how competitive it proves.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發布顯示中國實驗室能以積極價格與速度提供高代理能力，可能對前沿模型定價造成壓力。自報基準表現與即將開放的權重需獨立驗證，才能確認其實際競爭力。
items_flat.quote: M3.1 Flash achieves frontier-level intelligence across key tasks such as Cowork (Automation-Bench: 62%; ALE: 30%), Coding (DeepSWE: 74%) and Visual Reasoning (BabyVision: 91%), at 1/3 the cost of M3 and 3x the speed.
items_flat.quote_zh: M3.1 Flash 在關鍵任務上達到前沿級智能，例如 Cowork（Automation-Bench: 62%；ALE: 30%）、程式設計（DeepSWE: 74%）與視覺推理（BabyVision: 91%），成本僅為 M3 的三分之一、速度為其三倍。

brief_en: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to a new Public Benefit Fund that can grow with valuation. MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash, claiming major agentic and coding gains at lower cost with weights due soon. Other major labs stayed quiet on new flagship announcements.
brief_zh: Anthropic 將5%股份投入可隨估值成長的公益基金。MiniMax 推出 M3.1 Flash，宣稱代理與程式能力大躍進、成本下降，權重即將開放。其他大廠無重大新旗艦發布。
